build_latent_to_image_pipeline: build a LatentToImagePipeline that loads a VAE model and converts latent tensors to PIL images
run_latent_to_image_call: run the LatentToImagePipeline with a torch tensor of latents to decode and return a PIL image
create_vae_autoencoder: create an AutoencoderKL VAE model from a Hugging Face model ID with configurable torch dtype
refactor_process_req: refactor the _process_req method to handle latent denormalization and VAE decoding with upcasting support
review_model_to_gpu: review the _model_to_gpu method that moves the VAE model to CUDA when available
